description: Agentforce and Data 360 credit consumption first, then the contractual usage-based entitlements: consumption against allowance, projected end-of-period overage and utilization alerts.

panels.title: AI credits
panels.description: Generative AI credits consumed over the reported window. Requires Data 360. Requires a recent sfdx-hardis version on the monitoring pipeline (empty until then).

panels.title: Metered credits
panels.description: Share of AI credits that is billed. Requires Data 360. Requires a recent sfdx-hardis version on the monitoring pipeline (empty until then).

panels.title: AI actions
panels.description: Number of billed agent actions over the reported window. Requires Data 360. Requires a recent sfdx-hardis version on the monitoring pipeline (empty until then).

panels.title: Data 360 credits
panels.description: Data 360 credits consumed over the reported window. Requires Data 360. Requires a recent sfdx-hardis version on the monitoring pipeline (empty until then).

panels.title: Credit consumption evolution
panels.description: Agentforce and Data 360 credit consumption over time. Requires Data 360. Requires a recent sfdx-hardis version on the monitoring pipeline (empty until then).

panels.title: Cards in alert
panels.description: Distinct consumption cards for which Salesforce raised a utilization alert. Requires a recent sfdx-hardis version on the monitoring pipeline (empty until then).

panels.title: Highest alert
panels.description: Highest consumption threshold Salesforce has flagged across every card. Requires a recent sfdx-hardis version on the monitoring pipeline (empty until then).

panels.title: Consumption card thresholds
panels.description: Highest consumption threshold Salesforce has flagged on each Digital Wallet card. Salesforce exposes threshold crossings only, so a card reading 75% has passed 75%, not necessarily reached 78%. Requires a recent sfdx-hardis version on the monitoring pipeline (empty until then).

panels.title: Consumption card evolution
panels.description: How each consumption card has climbed through its thresholds over time. Requires a recent sfdx-hardis version on the monitoring pipeline (empty until then).

panels.title: Over allowance
panels.description: Entitlements whose paid allowance is already fully consumed, so overage is accruing now. Usage-based entitlements are what Salesforce bills on, unlike org limits which throttle. Requires a recent sfdx-hardis version on the monitoring pipeline (empty until then).

panels.title: Worst consumption
panels.description: Highest share of any single allowance consumed this period. Usage-based entitlements are what Salesforce bills on, unlike org limits which throttle. Requires a recent sfdx-hardis version on the monitoring pipeline (empty until then).

panels.title: Entitlements at risk
panels.description: Entitlements over allowance or on track to exceed it before the period ends. Usage-based entitlements are what Salesforce bills on, unlike org limits which throttle. Requires a recent sfdx-hardis version on the monitoring pipeline (empty until then).

panels.title: At risk avg (30d)
panels.description: Average number of entitlements at risk over 30 days. Requires a recent sfdx-hardis version on the monitoring pipeline (empty until then).

panels.title: Entitlement consumption
panels.description: Share of each purchased allowance already consumed in the current period. Usage-based entitlements are what Salesforce bills on, unlike org limits which throttle. Requires a recent sfdx-hardis version on the monitoring pipeline (empty until then).

panels.title: Projected consumption at period end
panels.description: Consumption projected to the end of the billing period, from the share consumed versus the share of the period elapsed. Above 100% means the allowance is on track to be exceeded. Usage-based entitlements are what Salesforce bills on, unlike org limits which throttle. Requires a recent sfdx-hardis version on the monitoring pipeline (empty until then).

panels.title: Entitlement consumption (% used)
panels.description: Consumption of every metered entitlement over time. Usage-based entitlements are what Salesforce bills on, unlike org limits which throttle. Requires a recent sfdx-hardis version on the monitoring pipeline (empty until then).

panels.title: Overage cost
panels.description: Estimated cost of consumption beyond purchased allowances, in the currency configured for the org. Estimate computed from the rates configured in usageCost, not a figure published by Salesforce. Requires a recent sfdx-hardis version on the monitoring pipeline (empty until then).

panels.title: AI credit cost
panels.description: Estimated cost of billed Agentforce and Data 360 credits, in the currency configured for the org. Estimate computed from the rates configured in usageCost, not a figure published by Salesforce. Requires a recent sfdx-hardis version on the monitoring pipeline (empty until then).

panels.title: Overage avg (30d)
panels.description: Average estimated overage cost over 30 days. Estimate computed from the rates configured in usageCost, not a figure published by Salesforce. Requires a recent sfdx-hardis version on the monitoring pipeline (empty until then).

panels.title: Estimated cost evolution
panels.description: Estimated overage and AI credit cost over time. Estimate computed from the rates configured in usageCost, not a figure published by Salesforce. Requires a recent sfdx-hardis version on the monitoring pipeline (empty until then).

panels.title: Entitlements detail (latest run)
panels.description: Every usage-based entitlement of the latest run, including resources Salesforce reports no consumption for. Usage-based entitlements are what Salesforce bills on, unlike org limits which throttle. Requires a recent sfdx-hardis version on the monitoring pipeline (empty until then).

panels.title: Active utilization alerts (latest run)
panels.description: Consumption and license utilization alerts Salesforce raised on the org. Requires a recent sfdx-hardis version on the monitoring pipeline (empty until then).
